mapper.insert: INSERT INTO questions (id, content, type, points, quiz_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{content}, #{type, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{points}, #{quizId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE questions SET content = #{content}, type = #{type, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, points = #{points}, quiz_id = #{quizId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, content, type, points, quiz_id, created_at, updated_at FROM questions WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY created_at
